propositions: Minor version 0.12.0 release must be cut from main, bumping package versions in pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock lockstep.
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section must be retitled to [0.12.0] dated 2026-08-15 with curated entries; a pre-existing duplicate [Unreleased] header defect was discovered and merged during preflight.

Release commit requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; must pass Gerrit review (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no unresolved comments) and CI guard tests before submission to main.

release.yml dispatch from main must complete all 10 jobs (authorize, lockstep, build, test, evidence, publish to PyPI with approval, MCP Registry, GitHub Release); PyPI attestation and tag/release verification required.
Post-publication verification across PyPI, GitHub tag/release, MCP Registry, and Homebrew autobump; channel smoke test with probe_rebar.py must pass with zero failures.
